title: Switching CDS Agencies in Missouri: What Changes and What Stays the Same
short_title: Switching your CDS agency to Caring Companions
description: Already in Missouri's Consumer Directed Services (CDS) program with another agency? You can switch. There's no new assessment, your authorization and hours move with you, your care doesn't pause, you can keep your caregiver, and your employer tax numbers go with you. Here's how it works.

parts.head: Switching your CDS agency
parts.sub: How it works, and what stays the same
parts.text: Already in Missouri's CDS program with another agency, and thinking about switching? You can. I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Here's how switching works, and what stays the same.

parts.head: You choose your agency
parts.sub: If it isn't working, you can move
parts.text: In CDS, you choose your provider agency. If it isn't working, or you'd like better support, you can move.

parts.head: No new assessment
parts.sub: Your authorization and hours move with you
parts.text: Here's the good news. Switching isn't a new enrollment. There's no new assessment. Your authorization and your hours move with you.

parts.head: Your care doesn't pause
parts.sub: Nothing changes until you say so
parts.text: Your care doesn't pause, either. Switching doesn't interrupt your care, and nothing about your current care changes until you say so.

parts.head: You can keep your caregiver
parts.sub: They work for you, not the agency
parts.text: And you can keep the same caregiver. In CDS, your caregiver works for you, not for the agency. We just set them up with us.

parts.head: Your employer numbers go with you
parts.sub: A switch takes days, not weeks
parts.text: Your two employer tax numbers belong to you, too. They go with you, so you don't apply again, or wait on the I R S. That makes a switch a matter of days, not weeks.

parts.head: Caregiver pay
parts.sub: Every agency sets its own. Ours: $15 to $16, every Thursday.
parts.text: Here's something many caregivers don't know. Every CDS agency sets its own caregiver pay. With us, it's fifteen to sixteen dollars an hour, paid every Thursday, by direct deposit or a pay card.

parts.head: Real support
parts.sub: Someone answers. Monthly check-ins, a yearly visit.
parts.text: When you call us, someone answers, Monday to Friday, nine to four. We check in by phone every month, and visit once a year.

parts.head: It's the consumer's decision
parts.sub: A caregiver can call first. The consumer makes the request.
parts.text: One thing to know. The switch is the consumer's decision. A caregiver is welcome to call us first, but we'll need to talk with the person getting care, and they make the request.

parts.head: Call, confirm, transfer
parts.sub: We handle the transfer and set up your caregiver
parts.text: Here's how it goes. You call us, and we answer your questions. The state calls you to confirm the switch. Then we handle the transfer, and set up your caregiver's payroll and clocking in.

parts.head: No pressure, ever
parts.text: And we'll never pressure anyone into switching. If you'd just like to ask questions, that's fine, too.
Thinking about switching? Call us at 417-218-2888, or visit caringcds.com. I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Thanks for watching.
